title: Frankie Wonga wins Drag Race Thailand Season 3
summary: At the Grand Finale (TH-S03-E10), Frankie Wonga and Zepee lip-synced to "ประวัติศาสตร์" by Christina Aguilar. Frankie Wonga was crowned the winner of Drag Race Thailand Season 3, with Zepee as runner-up.

title: Srirasha Hotsauce: Season 3 Porkchop
summary: Srirasha Hotsauce survived a first-episode lip sync but was eliminated the following week (TH-S03-E02), losing to "บุ๋ง" against Spicy Sunshine.
